code: (function(){if(!app.project.file||app.project.file.name!=='host-shape-native.aep')throw Error('Wrong project');var rows=[];for(var i=1;i<=app.project.numItems;i++){var c=app.project.item(i);if(!(c instanceof CompItem)||c.name.indexOf('HS_')!==0)continue;var l=c.layer(1),fx=l.property('ADBE Effect Parade');if(fx.numProperties){var p=fx.property(1);if(p.matchName==='DynamicFx Host Shape Probe'){p.property(2).setValue(2);p.property(5).setValue(0);}}rows.push({id:c.id,name:c.name,time:c.time,adjustment:l.adjustmentLayer});}app.project.save();return JSON.stringify({file:app.project.file.name,version:app.version,bpc:app.project.bitsPerChannel,comps:rows});})()
